question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me find out which customer segments spent more than 1,000,000 at premium gas stations in the Czech Republic, and show the total spent for each segment?

SELECT
    c.Segment,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spent
FROM customers AS c
JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN gasstations AS gs ON t.GasStationID = gs.GasStationID
WHERE gs.Country = 'CZE' AND gs.Segment = 'Premium'
GROUP BY c.Segment
HAVING SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) > 1000000;

question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me figure out which customer segment had the highest total fuel consumption (in litres) at the Premium gas stations in the Czech Republic during 2012? I'd love to see the total amount of fuel per segment.

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT c."Segment" AS segment,
       SUM(t."Amount") AS total_fuel
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN "gasstations" g ON t."GasStationID" = g."GasStationID"
JOIN "customers" c ON t."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
WHERE g."Country" = 'CZE'
  AND g."Segment" = 'Premium'
  AND strftime('%Y', t."Date") = '2012'
GROUP BY c."Segment"
ORDER BY total_fuel DESC
LIMIT 1;

question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me figure out, for each customer segment, which year‑month they spent the most money on fuel, what that total spend was, and which product they bought the most in that month? I'd love to see the segment, the YYYYMM, the total amount spent, and the top‑selling product name.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH seg_month AS (
       SELECT c.Segment,
              strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS yymm,
              SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spend
       FROM transactions_1k t
       JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       GROUP BY c.Segment, yymm
   ),
   ranked_month AS (
       SELECT Segment, yymm, total_spend,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS rn
       FROM seg_month
   ),
   top_month AS (
       SELECT Segment, yymm, total_spend
       FROM ranked_month
       WHERE rn = 1
   ),
   product_totals AS (
       SELECT c.Segment,
              strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS yymm,
              p.Description,
              SUM(t.Amount) AS product_amount
       FROM transactions_1k t
       JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
       JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
       GROUP BY c.Segment, yymm, p.Description
   ),
   ranked_product AS (
       SELECT Segment, yymm, Description,
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment, yymm ORDER BY product_amount DESC) AS rn
       FROM product_totals
   ),
   top_product AS (
       SELECT Segment, yymm, Description
       FROM ranked_product
       WHERE rn = 1
   )
SELECT tm.Segment,
       tm.yymm AS YYYYMM,
       tm.total_spend,
       tp.Description AS top_product_name
FROM top_month tm
JOIN top_product tp
  ON tm.Segment = tp.Segment AND tm.yymm = tp.yymm;

WITH seg_month AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         replace(strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date), '-', '') AS ym,
         SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spend
  FROM "transactions_1k" t
  JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.Segment, ym
),
best_month AS (
  SELECT Segment, ym, total_spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS rn
  FROM seg_month
),
best_month_filtered AS (
  SELECT Segment, ym, total_spend
  FROM best_month
  WHERE rn = 1
),
seg_month_product AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         replace(strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date), '-', '') AS ym,
         p.ProductID,
         p.Description,
         SUM(t.Amount) AS total_qty
  FROM "transactions_1k" t
  JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
  GROUP BY c.Segment, ym, p.ProductID, p.Description
),
best_product AS (
  SELECT smp.Segment,
         smp.ym,
         smp.Description,
         smp.total_qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY smp.Segment, smp.ym ORDER BY smp.total_qty DESC) AS rn
  FROM seg_month_product smp
  JOIN best_month_filtered bmf ON smp.Segment = bmf.Segment AND smp.ym = bmf.ym
)
SELECT bmf.Segment,
       bmf.ym,
       bmf.total_spend,
       bp.Description AS top_product
FROM best_month_filtered bmf
JOIN best_product bp ON bmf.Segment = bp.Segment AND bmf.ym = bp.ym
WHERE bp.rn = 1;

WITH seg_month_spend AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS YYYYMM,
         SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spent
  FROM customers c
  JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.Segment, YYYYMM
),
seg_month_max AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         YYYYMM,
         total_spent,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS rn
  FROM seg_month_spend
),
top_month AS (
  SELECT Segment, YYYYMM, total_spent
  FROM seg_month_max
  WHERE rn = 1
),
seg_month_product AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS YYYYMM,
         p.ProductID,
         p.Description,
         SUM(t.Amount) AS total_qty
  FROM customers c
  JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
  JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
  GROUP BY c.Segment, YYYYMM, p.ProductID, p.Description
),
top_product AS (
  SELECT sm.Segment,
         sm.YYYYMM,
         sm.total_spent,
         smp.Description AS top_product,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.Segment ORDER BY smp.total_qty DESC) AS rn2
  FROM top_month sm
  JOIN seg_month_product smp
    ON sm.Segment = smp.Segment
   AND sm.YYYYMM = smp.YYYYMM
)
SELECT Segment,
       YYYYMM,
       total_spent AS total_amount_spent,
       top_product
FROM top_product
WHERE rn2 = 1;

The products table only contains a Description column (e.g., 'Rucní zadání', 'Nafta', 'Special', 'Super', 'Natural'), but there is no column or external mapping indicating which of these are fuel. Without this definition, we cannot filter transactions to fuel purchases, compute spend per segment per month, or identify the top‑selling product. WITH cust_month AS (

           substr(t.Date,1,7) AS YYYYMM,
           t.CustomerID,

    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment, YYYYMM, t.CustomerID
),
seg_month AS (

           SUM(CustSpend) AS SegmentSpend
    FROM cust_month
    GROUP BY Segment, YYYYMM
),
best_month AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           YYYYMM AS BestMonth,
           SegmentSpend AS TotalSpend,

),

    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY c.Segment, YYYYMM, p.ProductID, p.Description
),
top_product AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           YYYYMM,

SELECT bm.Segment,

 AND bm.BestMonth = tp.YYYYMM

WITH SegmentYearSpend AS (

top_products_in_peak AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) as YearMonth,
        p.Description as ProductName,
        COUNT(*) as PurchaseCount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Segment, strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as product_rank
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    INNER JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY c.Segment, strftime('%Y%m', t.Date), p.Description

FROM ranked_peaks rp
INNER JOIN top_products_in_peak tp ON rp.Segment = tp.Segment AND rp.YearMonth = tp.YearMonth
WHERE rp.peak_rank = 1 AND tp.product_rank = 1
ORDER BY rp.Segment;

WITH MonthlySegmentSpend AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS YYYYMM,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS TotalSpend
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment, strftime('%Y%m', t.Date)
),
PeakMonths AS (
    SELECT mss.Segment, mss.YYYYMM, mss.TotalSpend
    FROM MonthlySegmentSpend mss
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT Segment, MAX(TotalSpend) AS MaxSpend
        FROM MonthlySegmentSpend
        GROUP BY Segment
    ) pm ON mss.Segment = pm.Segment AND mss.TotalSpend = pm.MaxSpend
),
ProductCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) AS YYYYMM,
        p.Description AS ProductName,
        COUNT(*) AS ProductFrequency
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY c.Segment, strftime('%Y%m', t.Date), p.Description
),
TopProducts AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment, pc.YYYYMM, pc.ProductName
    FROM ProductCounts pc
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT Segment, YYYYMM, MAX(ProductFrequency) AS MaxFreq
        FROM ProductCounts
        GROUP BY Segment, YYYYMM
    ) tp ON pc.Segment = tp.Segment AND pc.YYYYMM = tp.YYYYMM AND pc.ProductFrequency = tp.MaxFreq
)
SELECT 
    pm.Segment,
    pm.YYYYMM,
    pm.TotalSpend,
    tp.ProductName AS TopProductName
FROM PeakMonths pm
LEFT JOIN TopProducts tp ON pm.Segment = tp.Segment AND pm.YYYYMM = tp.YYYYMM
ORDER BY pm.Segment;

WITH
